'''Jayke Ball Bring Him Before Me DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-11630">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11630 DeckTech post 11630], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 8 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11630/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11630/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018095343/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11630/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Luke Skywalker  The emporer's @#$%'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' November 8, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' BHBM deck

=== Strategy ===

This a pretty basic, but solid BHBM deck. It can hold it's ground against most anything. Basically sense or alter what you can, then grapple anything else. Play circle on ben, then kill off whatever else with your sabers and dr. evason. Play lateral Damage on thier mon calamaries and kill off with executor. AGAINST PROFIT Either start Mara and Jabba, or Jabba and evason. Then get everyone to jabba's apalce. Be shure to sense SOWLY, so they can be cheap. Get out secret plans to stop retriving by opponent. PLay sniper on han, and win AGAINST HB get out secrutiy precations and probe. Sense and retvival cards AGAINST EBO Start Decree, and secret plans. move all your guys to hoth and beatdown and drain. Kill off in space with BH ships and lateral damage

anything else react to what opponent does pretty much

PLEASE REVIEW THANKS
